evals.prompt: $create-chrome-extension Build a toolbar extension that closes every tab except the active one, then install and verify it.
evals.expected_output: Clarifies pinned-tab and multi-window behavior, builds a least-permission Manifest V3 extension, runs tailored real-Chrome E2E and DevTools MCP checks, then installs or reports one protected UI action.

evals.prompt: /addonry:create-chrome-extension On this product page, collect every PDF link in DOM order and copy unique absolute URLs.
evals.expected_output: Inspects representative page with Chrome DevTools MCP, confirms origin and duplicate rules, builds page-specific extension with narrow access, tests fixture and live page, and installs it.

evals.prompt: /skill:create-chrome-extension Make a cookie exporter for only example.com that never logs values and writes local JSON.
evals.expected_output: Treats cookie values as credentials, confirms fields and security risks, requests narrow cookie/host permissions, validates redaction and export behavior, and refuses broader session extraction.
